definitions: An infection of the intestine caused by the amoeba Entamoeba histolytica, characterized by severe diarrhea with blood and mucus.
A form of dysentery resulting from infection with amoebas.
examples: The patient was diagnosed with amebic dysentery.
Contaminated water can spread amebic dysentery.
Symptoms of amebic dysentery include abdominal pain.
